params.body:
## What changes

**Preview** in the editor bar, for posts once something is written. It saves what is on screen, asks the pipeline for a preview link and opens it in a new tab. The tab opens on the click itself so the browser does not block it.

**From the sources** in the + menu of the text, next to Image. It shows the same list and the same usage-rights warning as the cover. A pick is copied into the piece by the pipeline and placed as a body image with an empty caption. Under it the editor shows which of the piece's sources it came from, with a link to the source.

## Checked

- `npm test` 62/62, `vite build` clean.
- Local run: the picker, a pick placed under a section with its credit, Preview opening the local site.

Merge last: after Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#420, then Trendwolves/gentells-site#248. This replaces #74, which was made on the main from before #73 and conflicts with it now; the change is the same.
params.title: Preview in the editor bar, and images from the sources in the text
